title: 第五十四章 破冰第五十章 山地精
lines: 西隆走到火堆前，看了一眼，对莫奇和比多点点头。
龙类从来不知道客套和谦让是为何物，得到西隆的首肯之后，幼龙们立刻开动，克莱利一口咬下半扇野猪，莫奇品尝着不知名的瓜果，比多对风干的肉更感兴趣，抓走拿到一边。
幼龙们各寻食物，低头咀嚼。
七八名山地精战士站在一边，看着狩猎的食物和部落的存粮，在眨眼之间被几条龙一扫而空，脸上都露出了不忿的神情，唯独头领亚兹神情平静，默默的不说话。
西隆不顾克莱利的护食，把剩下的野猪肉拖走，按在爪下吃了，示意亚兹到身边来。
“西隆·索拉克斯，这是我的名字。”
西隆说出自己的名姓，问：“关于熊人族，你们知道多少。”
亚兹愣了一下，他毫不怀疑这些龙类的观察能力，幼龙们在山洞里行走，肯定能看出山地精将青壮和财物转移的事实。
他已经准备好迎接白龙头领的怒火，可没想到白龙下来之后，神态语调都很平静，不仅没有兴师问罪，反倒先谈起熊人族的事情来。
只一句话，原本紧张戒备的氛围忽然就松解了，亚兹心里翻滚的焦虑被压了下去，反复斟酌的说辞也没了用武之地。
“风吟台地总共有三个部族，熊人族是最强大的，有一千个雄健的战士，他们的爪牙本身就是武器，还会使用战斧和长矛。”
亚兹嘴唇翕动，思索片刻：“即是山地精和穴居人联合起来，也无法战胜他们。”
“一千个。”
西隆微微点头：“说说沃姆吧，你之前提到的熊人头领。”
“沃姆是一个拥有施法能力的熊人，即使是在风吟台地的历史上，这种情况都十分罕见，他被熊人们称为熊王，引领了整个熊人部族崛起。”
亚兹说：“那家伙强壮到了不讲道理的地步，四年前我们与穴居人一起和熊人族打仗，穴居人设计埋伏，引来一只六级灾害的凶暴巨狼，想要将沃姆扑杀。”
亚兹看了克莱利一眼，似乎在比较钴龙和凶暴巨狼的体型：“沃姆赤手空拳，带着雷暴和巨狼搏斗，最后骑在巨狼身上，把凶暴巨狼的头骨掀了起来，后来还把狼皮做成一件大氅，披在自己身上。”
“我没去过熊人山寨，但听逃回来的穴居人说，那地方就是一座血腥的屠宰场，墙上挂着兽皮和人皮，公熊们围绕着篝火厮咬生食，沃姆坐在高高的白骨堆上，俯视着这一切。”
亚兹沉默了一下，最后说：“其实，自从沃姆徒手杀狼的事迹流传以后，他便开始号称是风吟台地的主人了。”
“风吟台地的主人，是烬痕家族。”西隆说。
亚兹低下头去：“风吟台地的主人，永远是烬痕家族。”
“不过，你口中描述的熊人族，和我们见到的熊人族，并不一样。”
旁边的克莱利插嘴：“熊人们对我们很恭敬，说要小心其他氏族图谋不轨，紧接着你便告诉我们，说熊人族自称风吟台地的主人，你说，我们应该相信谁？”
“我不敢替巨龙做选择，只是山地精的先祖曾经教导我们，熊类是狡猾的种族。”
亚兹说：“在弱势的时候，山熊会装出呆蠢憨厚的样子，可一旦发现进攻的时机，它们就会暴起吃人。”
“这岂不是跟我们霸主一样？”
content_en:
Shillong walked to the fire, took a look, and nodded to Mochi and Bido.
Dragons have never known the meaning of politeness and humility. After receiving Shillong's approval, the young dragons immediately started to move. Clery bit off half of the wild boar in one bite, and Mochi tasted the unknown fruits. Bido was more interested in the dried meat, so he grabbed it and put it aside.
The young dragons each looked for food and lowered their heads to chew.
Seven or eight mountain goblin warriors stood aside, watching as the hunting food and the tribe's food reserves were swept away by several dragons in the blink of an eye, with expressions of displeasure on their faces. Only the leader, Yaz, looked calm and silent.
Ignoring Clery's protection, Shillong dragged the remaining wild boar meat away, ate it under his paws, and motioned for Yaz to come to him.
"Silon Thorax, this is my name."
Shillong said his name and asked: "How much do you know about the Bear Tribe."
Yaz was stunned for a moment. He had no doubt about the observation ability of these dragons. When the young dragons were walking in the cave, they would definitely be able to see the fact that the mountain goblins were transferring young people and property.
He was ready to face the anger of the leader of the White Dragon, but he did not expect that after the White Dragon came down, his demeanor and tone were very calm. Not only did he not raise an army to ask questions, but he started talking about the Ursine Tribe.
With just one word, the originally tense and guarded atmosphere suddenly relaxed. The anxiety rolling in Yaz's heart was suppressed, and the words he had repeatedly considered were of no use.
"There are three tribes in total in the Wind Song Platform. The Bear Tribe is the most powerful. There are a thousand powerful warriors. Their minions are weapons themselves, and they can also use battle axes and spears."
Yaz's lips moved and he thought for a moment: "Even if the mountain goblins and cavemen unite, they will not be able to defeat them."
"A thousand."
Shillong nodded slightly: "Let's talk about Worm, the bear leader you mentioned before."
"Worm is a bear who has the ability to cast spells. Even in the history of Windsing Mesa, this situation is very rare. He is called the Bear King by the bears and leads the rise of the entire bear tribe."
Yaz said: "That guy is so strong that it's unreasonable. Four years ago, we fought with the cavemen against the bear tribe. The cavemen planned an ambush and attracted a ferocious giant wolf with a level six disaster, trying to kill Worm."
Yaz glanced at Clery and seemed to be comparing the size of the cobalt dragon and the dire giant wolf: "Worm fought with the giant wolf with his bare hands and thunderstorm. Finally, he rode on the giant wolf and lifted the skull of the dire giant wolf. Later, he made the wolf skin into a big cloak and draped it on himself."
"I have never been to the Bear Man's Village, but I heard from the cavemen who escaped that the place was a bloody slaughterhouse. Animal and human skins were hung on the walls. Male bears were eating raw food around a campfire. Worm was sitting on a tall pile of bones, looking down at it all."
Yaz was silent for a moment, and finally said: "Actually, since Worm's deeds of killing wolves with his bare hands spread, he has begun to claim to be the master of Wind Song Terrace."
"The owners of Fengyin Terrace are the Jinhen family." Xilong said.
"Yes."
Yaz lowered his head: "The owner of the Wind Song Terrace will always be the Jinhen family."
"However, the bear people you described are different from the bear people we saw."
Clary, who was next to him, interrupted: "The bears were very respectful to us and said we should be careful of other clans' evil intentions. Then you told us that the bears claimed to be the masters of the Windsing Terrace. Who should we believe?"
"I dare not make a choice for the dragon, but the ancestors of the mountain goblins once taught us that bears are a cunning race."
Yaz said: "When they are weak, mountain bears will pretend to be stupid and honest, but once they find the opportunity to attack, they will lash out and eat people."
"Isn't this the same as our overlord?"
